cn: 我们在城市里或许如同盒子一般被层层堆叠，但这种居住方式却带来了乡村难以企及的能源使用效率。

en: Rural energy requirements result in higher carbon emissions per person than in the city, so it is actually irresponsible to endorse such a lifestyle choice. (25 words)
cn: 乡村地区的能源需求，导致其人均碳排放量高于城市，因此，倡导这样一种生活方式选择，实际上是不负责任的。

en: Protecting the countryside is a hot topic. (7 words)
cn: 保护乡村，是当下的一个热门话题。

en: Those who have made their fortunes in the city often buy second homes in the countryside, visiting intermittently for a sample of a supposedly simple life. (26 words)
cn: 那些在城市中积累了财富的人，常常会在乡村购置第二套住宅，偶尔前往小住，体验一下所谓“简单质朴”的生活。

en: The side-effect of this is that house prices are pushed up due to increased demand, leaving them unaffordable for local people. (21 words)
cn: 这样做带来的一个副作用是，需求的增加推高了房价，使得当地居民再也难以负担得起。

en: A solution has yet to be found for this challenge, for market forces are further forcing residents out of the countryside. (21 words)
cn: 这一难题目前尚未找到解决之道，因为市场力量正在进一步把当地居民逼出乡村。

en: For those who believe in rural preservation, this is deplorable. (10 words)
cn: 对于那些坚信应当保护乡村传统的人来说，这实在令人痛心。

en: Whilst an idealised view of the countryside is common, the reality is that rural life has continuously evolved. (18 words)
cn: 尽管人们对乡村常常抱有一种理想化的看法，但现实是，乡村生活其实一直在持续演变。

en: Industrialisation brought an increase in divisions of labour, changing social links between rural people. (14 words)
cn: 工业化带来了分工的日益细化，也改变了乡村居民之间原有的社会联系。

en: The internet has introduced once foreign cultures into the countryside. (10 words)
cn: 互联网则将曾经陌生遥远的各种文化，引入了乡村。

en: Improved travel connections and affordability have made the world more accessible, creating a 'global village.' (15 words)
cn: 交通联系的改善和出行成本的降低，让世界变得更加触手可及，也由此催生出了一个“地球村”。

en: Considering these changes, surely an evolving countryside is inevitable. (9 words)
cn: 考虑到这些变化，乡村的持续演变，显然是不可避免的。

en: Perhaps the countryside should also prepare itself for massive population increases in the future. (14 words)
cn: 或许，乡村也应当为未来人口的大规模增长做好准备。

en: With cities across the world growing rapidly, how will the current urban generation respond to the inevitable social changes of mass urbanisation? (22 words)
cn: 随着世界各地的城市快速扩张，当下这一代城市居民，又将如何应对大规模城市化所必然带来的种种社会变迁呢？

en: Will the longing for a simpler life become stronger, fueling a rural renaissance? (13 words)
cn: 人们对简单生活的向往，是否会因此变得更加强烈，从而推动一场“乡村复兴”？

en: As the world continues to urbanise, the voices calling for rural preservation may well grow louder. (16 words)
cn: 随着世界持续城市化，呼吁保护乡村的声音，或许也会变得愈发响亮。

en: But change is inevitable. (4 words)
cn: 但变化终究是不可避免的。

en: We know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities, but the future of the countryside is less clear. (30 words)
cn: 我们知道，未来世界必将有新的城市从尘土中崛起，也必将有现有城市逐步发展成超大城市，然而乡村的未来，却远没有那么清晰可辨。

en: Statements, like 'beauty is in the eye of the beholder,' are rarely questioned. (13 words)
cn: “情人眼里出西施”这样的说法，很少会受到人们的质疑。

en: They've become so embedded in our consciousness that people think it's absurd to think otherwise. (15 words)
cn: 这类观念早已深深植根于我们的意识之中，以至于人们会觉得，若持相反看法简直荒谬。

en: It might be useful, however, to at least push back on this assumption because people evaluate environment, situations, and people aesthetically. (21 words)
cn: 然而，至少去审视、质疑一下这一假设，或许是有益的，因为人们本就会对环境、情境和他人做出审美层面的评判。

en: We may find that we still believe it is correct, but we may also find that there is a lot more to the situation than you suppose. (27 words)
cn: 我们或许最终会发现，自己依然认同这一说法是正确的，但我们也可能会发现，事情远比想象中要复杂得多。

en: A recent study exploring aesthetic taste was published in Cognition. (10 words)
cn: 一项探讨审美品味的最新研究，发表在了《认知》（Cognition）期刊上。

en: The results from this study show that people agree very much in their aesthetic evaluation of natural objects, but they disagree more about artifacts, or human-made objects. (27 words)
cn: 该研究的结果显示，人们在对自然事物的审美评价上高度一致，但在对人造物品——即人类制造的物品——的评价上，分歧则要大得多。

en: The study found that shared taste was most common for faces and natural landscapes, but least common among works of architecture and art. (23 words)
cn: 该研究发现，人们的审美共识在面孔和自然风景方面最为常见，而在建筑和艺术作品方面则最为少见。

en: The hypothesis is the commonly pleasing features, like proportion or symmetry, are at work. (14 words)
cn: 其假设是，诸如比例或对称之类普遍令人愉悦的特征，正在其中发挥作用。

en: Preferences for natural scenes might be learned through life experiences. (10 words)
cn: 人们对自然景观的偏好，或许是通过生活经验习得的。

en: Factors like habitability, safety, and openness might be preferred as people develop. (12 words)
cn: 随着人的成长，诸如宜居性、安全感和开阔感之类的因素，可能会逐渐成为人们所偏好的特质。

en: Some of the details of landscapes change, but the basics are more common, e.g., water, open spaces, and signs of care. (21 words)
cn: 风景中的一些具体细节或许各有不同，但其基本要素却更为普遍共通，例如水源、开阔的空间，以及被人悉心照料过的痕迹。

en: Art and architecture, unlike natural spaces, do not have the same level of exposure. (14 words)
cn: 与自然空间不同，艺术和建筑并不具备同等程度的“曝光度”，即人们接触它们的频率有限。

en: So, people do not have the same level of shared taste. (11 words)
cn: 因此，人们在这方面也就难以形成同等程度的审美共识。

en: It's possible that the lower amount of agreement in the shared taste of artifacts has to do more with elements of style, rather than 'behavioral consequences.' (26 words)
cn: 人们在人造物品审美上共识度较低，其原因或许更多与风格层面的因素有关，而非所谓的“行为后果”。

en: All of the consequences seem reasonable (or at least possible), but I think there might be an interesting philosophical conclusion that they did not draw. (25 words)
cn: 上述这些解释似乎都合情合理（或者至少是有可能成立的），但我认为，其中或许还隐含着一个颇为有趣、却未被研究者们提炼出来的哲学结论。

en: It seems that there is an objective ground to our aesthetic preferences or evaluations. (14 words)
cn: 看起来，我们的审美偏好或评判，其实是存在某种客观依据的。

en: I am not saying this would mean beauty is completely objective, just that there could possibly be general objective principles at work, i.e., beauty is not simply in the eye of the beholder. (33 words)
cn: 我并不是说这就意味着美是完全客观的，我想说的只是，或许确实存在一些普遍性的客观原则在其中发挥作用——也就是说，美并不单纯只是“情人眼里出西施”那么简单。

en: Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features, such as radiance, in a common way throughout the world. (18 words)
cn: 自然界会以一种放之四海而皆准的方式，展现出诸如光彩这类具有普遍性的审美特征。

en: It's not exactly the same everywhere, but it is common. (10 words)
cn: 这种特征并非在世界各地都完全一致，但确实具有相当程度的普遍性。

en: For example, a sunset is similar enough in different places to warrant almost universal appeal. (15 words)
cn: 例如，不同地方的日落景象，其相似程度足以让它几乎在世界各地都能唤起同样的美感。

en: Possible universal principles of beauty—such as proportion, fittingness, radiance, and others—are general categories, which allow for a wide array of embodiments. (21 words)
cn: 诸如比例、适宜性、光彩等可能存在的普遍美学原则，本质上都是一些宽泛的类别，可以容纳极为多样的具体表现形式。

en: When people get involved in making artifacts in architecture or art, they apply these very general concepts in unique ways. (20 words)
cn: 当人们参与建筑或艺术等人造物品的创作时，会以各自独特的方式，去运用这些十分宽泛的概念。

en: But the way they applied the principle may not have universal appeal. (12 words)
cn: 但他们运用这些原则的具体方式，却未必能够获得放之四海而皆准的美学认可。

en: This is why it's important to experience diverse cultures and their artifacts because it opens us up to different ways of approaching or constructing beauty. (25 words)
cn: 这正是为何体验多元文化及其各类人造物品如此重要——因为这能够为我们打开一扇窗，让我们领略到理解和构建“美”的种种不同方式。

en: And it is always good to question our assumptions. (9 words)
cn: 而对我们既有的种种假设保持质疑，无论何时都是一件好事。

en: About 23% of the global population lives in absolute poverty. (10 words)
cn: 全球约23%的人口生活在绝对贫困之中。

en: In developing countries there is a low life expectancy, a high infant mortality (Q26: J) rate, high levels of unemployment and illiteracy, nutritional levels below acceptable standards and widespread disease with very little or poor quality medical assistance. (38 words)
cn: 在发展中国家，人均预期寿命较低，婴儿死亡率居高不下，失业率和文盲率也都处于高位，营养水平低于可接受标准，且由于医疗救助严重匮乏或质量低劣，疾病广泛蔓延。

en: Others live incredibly (Q27: H) wealthy and luxurious lives and so the wealth is distributed in a very unequal (Q28: O) manner. (22 words)
cn: 另一些人则过着极度富裕、奢华的生活，因此财富的分配方式也就变得极不均衡。

en: These are the central problems to questions of charity though charity also includes many other areas such as assisting the elderly. (21 words)
cn: 这些正是慈善所要面对的核心问题，尽管慈善所涉及的领域，还远不止这些，也包括诸如帮助老年人在内的许多其他方面。

en: We all applaud (Q29: A) when very rich people pledge to give away most of their billions, but they are usually left with millions to pass on, still much more than most people would expect to earn in their lifetime. (40 words)
cn: 每当那些身家巨富的人承诺要捐出自己大部分财富时，我们都会为之鼓掌喝彩，但实际上，他们留给自己的往往仍有数百万之巨——远远超过大多数人一生所能挣到的财富。

en: Even comparatively moderate (Q30: I) salaries in the west are very high when compared globally. (15 words)
cn: 即便是西方国家中相对适中的薪资水平，放到全球范围内来看，也已属于相当高的水平。

en: Someone on £20,000 could easily afford to give away £2,000 per year and still have plenty to live on plus some luxuries. (22 words)
cn: 一个年收入2万英镑的人，完全可以轻松拿出每年2000英镑捐出去，同时依然能过上宽裕的生活，甚至还能享受一些奢侈品。

en: Most people agree that giving to charity is morally praiseworthy (Q31: L) but charitable behaviour tends to be regarded as above and beyond the call of duty. (27 words)
cn: 大多数人都认同，向慈善机构捐款在道德上是值得称许的，但慈善行为往往被视为一种超出本分义务之外的额外善举。

en: Some argue, however, that charitable behaviour is morally required. (9 words)
cn: 然而，也有人认为，行善本身在道德上是一种应尽的义务。

en: This means that to fail to behave charitably would be wrong. (11 words)
cn: 这意味着，若不能以慈善之举行事，便是一种错误。

en: The majority of arguments in this vein refer to giving aid to poorer nations but they may also refer to giving time within one's immediate (Q32: G) community. (28 words)
cn: 这类论点大多聚焦于向较贫穷国家提供援助，但有时也涉及在自己所在的本地社区中付出时间。

en: Arguments tend to place different requirements on people in different income brackets and exclude (Q33: C) entirely people who are merely making ends meet. (24 words)
cn: 这些论点往往会对处于不同收入阶层的人提出不同的要求，同时完全把那些仅仅勉强维持生计的人排除在外。

en: Some argue that people should all contribute a certain percentage of their earnings. (13 words)
cn: 也有人主张，所有人都应当按一定比例贡献出自己的收入。

en: I will group (Q34: E) together all those arguments that place a moral requirement on people to give to charity, despite the fact that there is wide disagreement as to the extent (Q35: D) of that moral requirement. (38 words)
cn: 我将把所有那些认为人们在道德上有责任向慈善捐赠的论点归纳到一起，尽管对于这种道德责任究竟应到何种程度，人们之间依然存在着广泛的分歧。

en: A) Trade is one of the policy areas where the hostility that exists between populists and classical liberals is most visible. (21 words)
cn: A) 贸易是民粹主义者与古典自由主义者之间的敌意表现得最为明显的政策领域之一。

en: Free-traders point to the undeniable good that tariff-free trade has done for consumers across the world and to the observable alleviation of poverty in corners of the world where previously closed markets have been opened up. (36 words)
cn: 自由贸易的支持者会指出，免关税贸易为世界各地的消费者带来了不可否认的好处，也让曾经封闭的市场一旦开放，其所在地区的贫困状况便能获得明显缓解。

en: Protectionists point to the domestic producers who've paid the price for this globalized economy in the form of lost livelihoods and hollowed-out communities. (23 words)
cn: 而保护主义者则会指出，正是国内的生产者，为这种全球化经济付出了代价——他们失去了生计，所在的社区也因此逐渐衰败凋敝。

en: B) The ongoing conservative civil war often degenerates into content-free tribal warfare, but trade is a rare exception. (18 words)
cn: B) 保守派内部持续不断的“内战”，往往会沦为一场毫无实质内容的部落式混战，但贸易问题却是一个罕见的例外。

en: There are substantial, thought-out policy proposals on both sides of the argument. (12 words)
cn: 在这场争论中，双方都提出了实质性且经过深思熟虑的政策主张。

en: C) Consequently, trade as a topic of discussion provides an opportunity for liberals and populists to have a real meeting of minds. (22 words)
cn: C) 正因如此，贸易作为一个讨论话题，为自由主义者和民粹主义者提供了一个真正实现思想交汇的机会。

en: Fruitful debates might actually take place in this area, as opposed to the familiar ritual we've become accustomed to of condemnation met with counter-condemnation. (24 words)
cn: 在这一领域，富有成效的辩论或许真的能够展开，而不再是我们早已司空见惯的那种“互相指责、彼此反击”的固定套路。

en: D) Strange as it might sound, the problem with trade in the modern world isn't a matter of dollars and cents. (21 words)
cn: D) 听起来或许有些奇怪，但现代世界贸易问题的症结，其实并不在于金钱本身。

en: It's a matter of false consciousness. (6 words)
cn: 它其实是一个“虚假意识”的问题。

en: This observation is bound to set Marxist alarm bells ringing in the minds of some readers, but it was first made by Alexis de Tocqueville in 1840. (27 words)
cn: 这一观察必定会让一些读者联想到马克思主义的相关论述，心生警惕，但它其实最早是由阿列克西·德·托克维尔在1840年提出的。

en: E) Tracking the economic development of mankind from primitive to modern societies, Tocqueville observed a paradox unfolding over the centuries as economic realities and human experience of those realities strayed further and further from each other. (36 words)
cn: E) 在追溯人类社会从原始形态向现代社会演进的经济发展历程时，托克维尔观察到，随着几个世纪以来经济现实与人类对这一现实的切身感受渐行渐远，一种悖论也随之逐渐显现。

en: In primitive societies, he notes, the division of labor was as yet undeveloped for the most part, requiring each person, family, or tribe to be relatively independent when it came to meeting their own basic material needs. (37 words)
cn: 他指出，在原始社会中，分工在很大程度上尚未发展起来，这就要求每个个人、家庭或部落，在满足自身基本物质需求方面，都必须相对自给自足。

en: Men built their own dwellings, farmed their own land, tended to their own livestock. (14 words)
cn: 人们自己建造居所，自己耕种土地，自己饲养牲畜。

en: This is not to deny that basic forms of trade took place, but, for the most part, our primitive ancestors lived fairly self-reliant, if crushingly poor, lives. (27 words)
cn: 这并不是要否认基本形式的贸易确实存在过，但总体而言，我们的原始祖先所过的，是一种相当自给自足、却也极为贫困艰辛的生活。

en: F) However, the exclusively local and face-to-face nature of economic and political organization in the ancient and prehistoric worlds constantly impressed upon these primitive peoples the uncontrollable reality of others and their needs. (33 words)
cn: F) 然而，古代及史前世界经济与政治组织完全局限于本地、依赖面对面互动的这一特性，也不断让这些原始族群深刻体会到——他人的存在及其需求，是一种无法回避、也无法掌控的现实。

en: As Tocqueville notes, "as soon as a man begins to deal with common affairs in public, he begins to perceive that he is not so independent of his fellow men as he had first imagined, and that in order to obtain their support he must often lend them his cooperation." (50 words)
cn: 正如托克维尔所指出的：“一个人一旦开始参与公共事务，便会逐渐意识到，自己并不像最初想象的那样独立于同胞之外，为了获得他人的支持，他也往往必须付出自己的合作。”

en: G) At the advent of the modern world, the division of labor spread further and further throughout society. (18 words)
cn: G) 随着现代世界的到来，社会分工在整个社会中不断扩展、日益细化。

en: Each person became more and more dependent on others for their basic needs. (13 words)
cn: 每个人在满足基本需求方面，也变得越来越依赖他人。

en: And yet, robbed of the engagement with our neighbors and with our local communities that our ancestors were forced into by circumstance, we feel ourselves to be more and more independent of one another. (34 words)
cn: 然而，我们的祖先曾被环境所迫、不得不与邻里及本地社区保持紧密联系，而这种联系一旦从我们身上被剥离，我们反倒感觉自己变得越来越独立于彼此之外。

en: As we become more and more dependent on others, we become less and less conscious of our dependence on others. (20 words)
cn: 我们对他人的依赖程度越来越深，但对这种依赖的自觉意识，却反倒越来越淡薄。

en: This is the paradox of trade in the modern world. (10 words)
cn: 这，就是现代世界贸易中的悖论所在。

en: H) The false consciousness that this paradox generates causes havoc on the debates we have about free trade. (18 words)
cn: H) 这种悖论所催生出的虚假意识，给我们围绕自由贸易展开的种种辩论，造成了极大的混乱。

en: There is scarcely a single commodity in any American household that isn't dependent for its manufacture and sale, through one supply chain or another, on scores of different people spread out across the entire globe. (35 words)
cn: 在任何一个美国家庭中，几乎找不出哪一件商品，在其生产和销售过程中，不需要依靠某一条供应链、依赖分布在全球各地的众多人员的付出。

en: But as Tocqueville already foresaw in 1840, we do not feel dependent on these strangers for our way of life. (20 words)
cn: 但正如托克维尔早在1840年就已预见到的那样，我们并不会觉得自己的生活方式，是依赖于这些陌生人的。

en: No sense of the dependence of our own material welfare on their work ever strikes our national consciousness. (18 words)
cn: 我们自身物质福祉对他们劳动成果的依赖，从未真正触动过我们整个国家的集体意识。

en: We rarely contemplate the globalized avenues of free trade with gratitude. (11 words)
cn: 我们也很少会怀着感激之情，去思考这条全球化的自由贸易之路。

en: I) There are two reasons for this. (7 words)
cn: I) 造成这种状况的原因有两个。

en: The first, to put it bluntly, is money. (8 words)
cn: 第一个原因，说白了，就是金钱。

en: Money allows us to purchase the work of others without giving any thought to them as human beings. (18 words)
cn: 金钱让我们得以购买他人的劳动成果，却完全无需把对方当作一个活生生的人来加以考虑。

en: Unlike our ancestors in their primitive townships, we rarely have to meet face-to-face the people who've invented, built, shipped, or supplied our goods. (23 words)
cn: 与我们生活在原始聚落中的祖先不同，我们如今几乎从不需要与那些发明、制造、运输或供应我们所用商品的人当面相见。

en: No relationship has to be built before an exchange can take place. (12 words)
cn: 在一次交易发生之前，双方之间根本不需要建立任何关系。

en: Simply agree on a price, and you can have any goods you wish without taking a second thought for the human being involved on the other side of the transaction. (30 words)
cn: 只需就价格达成一致，你便能获得自己想要的任何商品，完全无需为交易另一端那个活生生的人多加考虑。

en: In this way, money makes us feel more independent than we actually are. (13 words)
cn: 正是通过这种方式，金钱让我们感觉自己比实际上更加独立。

en: Each of us senses the hold that it has over our fellows. (12 words)
cn: 我们每个人，其实都能感受到金钱对我们同胞所拥有的这种支配力。

en: We know that if we bid highly enough we can buy ourselves out of the time-consuming labor of building relationships. (20 words)
cn: 我们心知肚明，只要出价足够高，就能把自己从耗时费力地建立人际关系这件事中“赎买”出来。

en: Money is kind of like magic in that way. (9 words)
cn: 从这个意义上说，金钱就有点像魔法一样。

en: It gives us a set of rituals to perform and promises that if we do so we'll be able to wield power over others. (24 words)
cn: 它赋予我们一整套可以执行的仪式，并向我们承诺，只要照做，我们便能对他人施加权力。

en: The illusion is created that having enough money to buy something is the equivalent of knowing how to make it yourself. (21 words)
cn: 由此便产生了一种错觉：只要有足够的钱去购买某样东西，就等同于自己掌握了制造它的本领。

en: Gratitude for the anonymous men and women who make up the supply chain rarely makes its way into our consciousness. (20 words)
cn: 而对那些构成整条供应链、却始终默默无闻的男男女女，我们心中的那份感激之情，也就很少会真正浮现出来。

en: J) Anonymity, in fact, is the second root cause of the free-trade paradox. (13 words)
cn: J) 而“匿名性”，事实上正是自由贸易悖论的第二个根源。

en: Modernity has emancipated everyone from the limits of location and community. (11 words)
cn: 现代性把每个人都从地域和社群的种种限制中解放了出来。

en: By and large, when we trade, we trade with strangers; when we vote, we vote for strangers; when we watch, read, or listen to stories, the tellers of the tales are strangers. (32 words)
cn: 总的来说，我们做生意时，交易对象是陌生人；我们投票时，投出的一票是给陌生人的；我们观看、阅读或聆听各种故事时，那些讲述故事的人，也同样是陌生人。

en: As opposed to the ancestors Tocqueville compares us to, we do not know the people with whom we have to do, in either the economic or the political sphere. (29 words)
cn: 与托克维尔笔下我们所对比的祖先不同，无论是在经济领域还是在政治领域，我们其实都不认识那些与我们打交道的人。

en: This is simply the shadow side of the miracle of markets, which, for the first time in history, have allowed strangers to look after each other. (26 words)
cn: 这不过是市场这一奇迹所投下的阴影一面而已——市场，第一次在人类历史上，使陌生人之间也能够彼此照应。

en: They've also allowed each of us to live more and more of our lives exclusively as strangers to other people. (20 words)
cn: 与此同时，它也让我们每个人，越来越多地把自己的生活，完全建立在与他人彼此陌生的状态之上。

en: This is how Tocqueville—rather pessimistically—describes us: Each, standing apart, is like a stranger to the destiny of others; his children and personal friends forming for him the entire human race. (30 words)
cn: 托克维尔正是这样——带着几分悲观——描述我们的：每个人都孤立地站着，仿佛与他人的命运彼此陌生；他的子女和亲密的朋友，就构成了他心目中的整个人类。

en: As for the remainder of his fellow citizens, he is beside them, but he does not see them. (18 words)
cn: 至于其余的同胞公民，他就站在他们身旁，却看不见他们。

en: He touches them, but he does not feel them. (9 words)
cn: 他触碰得到他们，却感受不到他们。

en: He exists only in and for himself. (7 words)
cn: 他只为自己而存在，也只活在自己之中。

en: K) The last sentence but one is as apt a summary as one could hope to come by of how each of us functions in the modern economy: "He touches them, but he does not feel them." (37 words)
cn: K) 倒数第二句话，堪称是对我们每个人在现代经济中运作方式最贴切的概括：“他触碰得到他们，却感受不到他们。”

en: L) This is the greatest challenge facing defenders of free trade. (11 words)
cn: L) 这正是自由贸易的捍卫者们所面临的最大挑战。

en: It's exceedingly difficult for human beings to feel gratitude toward strangers, and the global marketplace that has made us so rich has also made us strangers to one another. (29 words)
cn: 人类要对陌生人心怀感激，本就是极为困难的事情，而这个让我们变得如此富裕的全球化市场，同时也让我们彼此之间变成了陌生人。

en: Our brains are hardwired for tribal life, and tribes do not take kindly to strangers. (15 words)
cn: 我们的大脑天生就是为部落式的生活而构造的，而部落对陌生人向来并不友善。

en: Impressing a sense of dependence upon and gratitude toward foreign strangers is therefore an uphill task. (16 words)
cn: 因此，要让人们真正意识到自己对海外陌生人的依赖，并心怀感激，无疑是一项极为艰巨的任务。

en: M) If free-traders are going to win policy arguments in the future, they'll have to find a way of forging bonds of affection between American consumers and foreign producers. (29 words)
cn: M) 如果自由贸易的支持者希望在未来的政策辩论中获胜，他们就必须找到一种方法，在美国消费者与海外生产者之间建立起真正的情感纽带。

en: Only by de-anonymizing the men and women who supply us with the goods and services we enjoy from overseas and by creating a sense of solidarity and relationship across borders that transcends economic interest can free trade win the day. (40 words)
cn: 只有让那些为我们提供海外商品与服务的男男女女不再是匿名的存在，并在跨越国界的层面上，构建起一种超越经济利益本身的团结感与联系，自由贸易才有可能最终胜出。

en: Otherwise, the inborn biological upper hand that protectionists have in the form of nationalist solidarity is bound to win the day at the ballot box. (25 words)
cn: 否则，保护主义者凭借民族团结这一与生俱来的生物性优势，终将在选票的较量中占得上风。

en: There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant. (23 words)
cn: 网络上有数以百计的性格测试，都声称能够判断出你大脑的左半球还是右半球占据主导地位。

en: Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math while right-brained people are more imaginative, emotionally intelligent and skilled with spatial reasoning. (24 words)
cn: 据说，“左脑型”的人更擅长逻辑思维，在语言和数学方面表现出色，而“右脑型”的人则更具想象力，情商更高，也更擅长空间推理。

en: There's just one problem: That's not how brains work. (9 words)
cn: 但问题只有一个：大脑的实际运作方式，根本就不是这样的。

en: Popular science enthusiasts sort of took this idea and ran with it, and it's become woven in popular culture now, and it's not going away. (25 words)
cn: 科普爱好者们大致接过了这一说法，并将其大加发挥，如今它已经深深融入了流行文化，且丝毫没有消退的迹象。

en: Despite this enduring belief, there's no such thing as being "right-brained" or "left-brained." (13 words)
cn: 尽管这一观念根深蒂固、经久不衰，但事实上，所谓“右脑型”或“左脑型”的人，根本就不存在。

en: Whether you're someone who tends more towards creativity or logic has nothing to do with one hemisphere of your brain being dominant over the other. (25 words)
cn: 一个人究竟更偏向创造性思维还是逻辑思维，与大脑的某一半球是否占据主导地位，其实毫无关系。

en: But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction. (19 words)
cn: 但关于我们大脑两个半球究竟是如何协同运作的真正科学解释，有时候反倒比虚构的说法更加离奇。

en: The human brain is divided into two hemispheres, the left and right. (12 words)
cn: 人类的大脑分为左右两个半球。

en: In all vertebrate animals, the right hemisphere controls the left side of the body and vice versa. (17 words)
cn: 在所有脊椎动物体内，大脑右半球控制着身体的左侧，反之亦然。

en: And scientists have long known, thanks to the behaviors of patients who suffered brain injuries, that different areas of the brain do different things. (24 words)
cn: 得益于对脑损伤患者行为表现的观察研究，科学家们早已知道，大脑的不同区域各自承担着不同的功能。

en: But many scientists struggled with this idea, because the very suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain operate differently disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry. (31 words)
cn: 但许多科学家一度对这一观点心存疑虑，因为“大脑左右两半球运作方式有所不同”这一说法本身，恰恰挑战了“自然界总是趋向于完美对称”这一固有观念。

en: Work by neuroscientists has revealed the importance of different hemispheres of the brain for different activities. (16 words)
cn: 神经科学家们的研究工作，揭示出大脑不同半球对于不同活动的重要作用。

en: However, their research quickly saw some misinterpretations in the general public: Some presumed creative people must be right-brained and logical people left-brained. (22 words)
cn: 然而，他们的研究成果很快就在公众之中遭到了一些误读：有人想当然地认为，富有创造力的人一定是“右脑型”，逻辑思维强的人一定是“左脑型”。

en: It is proven that not only is personality unrelated to the different halves of the brain, but people aren't really right- or left-brained to begin with. (26 words)
cn: 事实已经证明，性格不仅与大脑左右两半球并无关联，人们从一开始也根本就不存在真正的“左脑型”或“右脑型”之分。

en: The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false. (20 words)
cn: “存在左脑主导型和右脑主导型的人，且这与性格相关”这种说法，完全是错误的。

en: That's never been supported in the neuroscience community. (8 words)
cn: 这种说法，从来都没有得到过神经科学界的支持。

en: Neuroscientists don't believe that and never have. (7 words)
cn: 神经科学家们从不相信这种说法，也从未相信过。

en: What scientists learned is that there are really important differences between the left hemisphere and the right hemisphere. (18 words)
cn: 科学家们了解到的是，大脑左右两个半球之间，确实存在着一些十分重要的差异。

en: It's just that they have nothing to do with personality or whether cognitive strategy is more logical or free spirited or creative. (22 words)
cn: 只不过，这些差异与性格无关，也与一个人的认知方式究竟更偏向逻辑、洒脱还是富有创造力毫无关系。

en: While researchers have shown the limitations of how the hemispheres of our brains influence our lives, it's not difficult to understand the appeal of such ideas. (26 words)
cn: 尽管研究者已经证明了大脑两半球对我们生活的影响其实相当有限，但这类说法为何如此吸引人，却也不难理解。

en: People are endlessly fascinated by themselves and their friends, and the subtle differences in how people think about the world are really meaningful to them. (25 words)
cn: 人们对自己以及身边朋友的兴趣，可以说是无穷无尽的，而人与人之间在思维方式上那些细微的差异，对他们来说，也确实具有真切的意义。

en: When you come up with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves, we're drawn to that. (18 words)
cn: 每当你看到一个能够揭示某些自我特质的网络测试时，就很容易被它吸引。

en: It's irresistible. (2 words)
cn: 这种吸引力，几乎让人无法抗拒。

en: But you have to take it with an enormous grain of salt. (12 words)
cn: 但对于这类测试的结果，你还是得抱以极大的怀疑态度。

en: One hundred thirty-five students, four teachers, one giant classroom: This is what 9th grade looks like at Westwood High School, in Mesa, Arizona's largest school system. (26 words)
cn: 135名学生，4位教师，1间超大教室：这就是亚利桑那州梅萨市——该州最大学区——韦斯特伍德高中九年级的日常景象。

en: There, an innovative teaching model has taken hold, and is spreading to other schools in the district and beyond. (19 words)
cn: 在那里，一种创新的教学模式已经落地生根，并正在向学区内外的其他学校不断推广开来。

en: Five years ago, faced with high teacher turnover and declining student enrollment, Westwood's leaders decided to try something different. (19 words)
cn: 五年前，面对教师流失率居高不下、学生入学人数不断下滑的局面，韦斯特伍德高中的管理者们决定尝试一些不一样的做法。

en: Working with professors at Arizona State University's teachers college, they piloted a classroom model known as team teaching, which allows teachers to dissolve the walls that separate their classes across physical or grade divides. (34 words)
cn: 他们与亚利桑那州立大学教师学院的教授们合作，试点推行了一种被称为“团队教学”的课堂模式，让教师们能够打破原本按空间或年级划分课堂的那道“隔墙”。

en: The teachers share large groups of students—sometimes 100 or more—and rotate between group instruction, one-on-one interventions, small study groups, or whatever the teachers as a team agree is a priority that day. (32 words)
cn: 教师们共同负责规模庞大的学生群体——有时多达100人甚至更多——并在集体授课、一对一辅导、小组学习之间灵活轮转，具体安排则取决于教师团队当天共同商定的优先事项。

en: What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day. (35 words)
cn: 这种局面有时看起来像是一片混乱，但实际上却是经过精心编排的计划：每天清晨，韦斯特伍德的教学团队都会碰头，为当天要重点关注的每一位学生，量身制定个性化的学习方案。

en: By giving teachers more opportunity to collaborate, Mesa's administrators hoped to fill staffing gaps and boost teacher morale and retention. (20 words)
cn: 通过为教师提供更多协作的机会，梅萨学区的管理者们希望能够填补师资缺口，同时提振教师士气、提高教师留任率。

en: Initial research suggests the gamble could pay off. (8 words)
cn: 初步的研究结果显示，这场“豪赌”或许真的有望取得成效。

en: "Teachers are doing fantastic things, but it's very rare a teacher walks into another room to see what's happening," said Andi Fourlis, superintendent of Mesa Public Schools. (27 words)
cn: 梅萨公立学区的督学安迪·福尔利斯说：“教师们其实都在做着了不起的事情，但一位教师走进另一间教室、去看看那里正在发生什么，这种情况却十分罕见。”

en: "Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation." (13 words)
cn: “我们这个职业之所以进步得如此缓慢，正是因为我们一直都是孤军奋战、各自为政。”

en: Of course, overhauling teaching approaches can't fix all the frustrations teachers have, such as low pay, but early results from Mesa show team teaching may be helping to reverse low morale. (31 words)
cn: 当然，改革教学方式并不能解决教师们所面临的所有困扰，比如薪资偏低的问题，但梅萨学区的早期成果显示，团队教学或许确实有助于扭转低迷的士气。

en: In a survey of hundreds of the district's teachers, researchers found those who worked on teams reported greater job satisfaction, more frequent collaborations with colleagues, and more positive interactions with students. (31 words)
cn: 在一项针对该学区数百名教师展开的调查中，研究人员发现，采用团队教学模式的教师，工作满意度更高，与同事之间的协作也更为频繁，与学生之间的互动也更加积极正面。

en: Another benefit of teams, teachers say, is that they can help each other improve their instruction. (16 words)
cn: 教师们表示，团队协作的另一个好处，是他们能够彼此帮助，改进各自的教学方式。

en: During one planning session, English teacher Jeff Hall shared a performance appraisal with a science teacher: Her recent lecture on something she called "the central dogma of biology" had bewildered him and their other teammates. (35 words)
cn: 在一次教学研讨会上，英语教师杰夫·霍尔向一位科学教师分享了一份教学效果反馈：她最近一堂关于所谓“生物学的中心法则”的课，让他和团队中的其他成员都感到一头雾水。

en: "If the science is too confusing for me, can you imagine the frustration you feel as kids?" Hall said. (19 words)
cn: 霍尔说：“如果连我这个科学课都听得云里雾里，你能想象孩子们该有多沮丧吗？”

en: But the science teacher, he said, wouldn't have known about the confusion on her own. (15 words)
cn: 但他也表示，如果没有这次反馈，那位科学教师恐怕根本不会意识到，自己的课让学生们感到如此困惑。

en: The model is not for everyone. (6 words)
cn: 这种教学模式，并非适合所有人。

en: Some teachers approached about volunteering for a team have said they prefer to work alone. (15 words)
cn: 曾有一些被邀请加入团队的教师表示，自己更愿意单独授课。

en: Team teaching can also be a scheduling nightmare, especially at schools like Westwood where only some staff work in teams. (20 words)
cn: 团队教学在排课安排上也可能变成一场噩梦，尤其是在像韦斯特伍德这样、只有部分教职工采用团队教学模式的学校里，情况更是如此。

en: There are also thorny questions like how to evaluate four teachers on the performance of 135 students. (17 words)
cn: 此外，还存在一些棘手的问题，比如该如何依据135名学生的学习表现，去评估四位教师各自的教学成效。

en: But for the time being, it seems to be working. (10 words)
cn: 但就目前而言，这套模式看起来确实是奏效的。

en: In her second year, Charlene Duong learned of the use of poisonous, synthetic pesticides on her college campus. (18 words)
cn: 在大二那年，夏琳·杜昂得知自己所在的大学校园里正在使用有毒的合成农药。

en: Shocked but not surprised, she knew she had to do something. (11 words)
cn: 她感到震惊，却并不意外，她知道自己必须采取行动。

en: Along with a couple of classmates, Charlene did a quick web search and discovered a small but growing movement led by the organization, Herbicide-Free Campus (HFC), to rid college campuses of artificial herbicides (灭草剂). (34 words)
cn: 夏琳和几位同学一起在网上快速搜索了一番，发现了一场规模虽小却正在壮大的运动——由“无除草剂校园”（HFC）这一组织发起，旨在让各大学校园摆脱人工除草剂的使用。

en: They were intrigued. (3 words)
cn: 他们对此产生了浓厚的兴趣。

en: Like many, Charlene experiences climate anxiety—a chronic fear of a climate catastrophe—and was, at the time, looking for an outlet. (20 words)
cn: 和许多人一样，夏琳也经历着“气候焦虑”——一种对气候灾难的长期恐惧——而当时的她，正在寻找一个宣泄和投入这种焦虑的出口。

en: When she discovered the HFC movement, she said she felt she "had found a specific area to focus on that still fit into the larger picture of fighting for a healthier, safer, cleaner environment for all." (36 words)
cn: 在发现HFC这场运动后，她说自己感觉“找到了一个可以具体专注的方向，而这个方向依然契合于为所有人争取更健康、更安全、更洁净的环境这一更宏大的图景”。

en: Toxic herbicide use in university land care is not unique. (10 words)
cn: 在大学校园土地养护中使用有毒除草剂，并非个别现象。

en: Most institutions of higher education rely on synthetic pesticides and fertilizers to achieve aesthetic goals. (15 words)
cn: 大多数高等院校都依赖合成农药和化肥，来实现校园美观方面的目标。

en: Having a "beautiful" campus means green and perfectly maintained lawns along with flower beds and paved sidewalks. (17 words)
cn: 拥有一个“美丽”的校园，意味着葱翠而修剪完美的草坪，配上花坛与铺装整齐的人行道。

en: But these conventionally managed campuses can come at a cost: increased cancer risk, contaminated waterways, poisoned wildlife and lifeless soil. (20 words)
cn: 但这种按传统方式管理的校园，也可能付出相应的代价：癌症风险上升、水道受到污染、野生动物中毒，以及土壤失去生机。

en: Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis. (12 words)
cn: 大学校园中农药的使用，也在加剧全球气候危机。

en: The use of chemicals to get rid of insects or unwanted plant life can increase indirect emissions, as they can include petroleum-based ingredients. (23 words)
cn: 使用化学品来消灭昆虫或不需要的植物，可能会增加间接排放，因为这些化学品中往往含有石油基成分。

en: Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, hampering the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods. (36 words)
cn: 农药的使用还会削减土壤中的生命活力，妨碍土壤吸收碳、保持水分的能力，从而降低校园在面对干旱、洪涝等与气候相关的极端天气事件时迅速恢复的能力。

en: Instead of using toxic chemicals, students working with HFC help out with weeding the campus grounds. (16 words)
cn: 与其使用有毒化学品，与HFC合作的学生们选择亲手帮忙给校园除草。

en: "This work reminds me to be in the present moment as I play my role in reducing herbicide use and keeping my campus safe and healthy," says Charlene. (28 words)
cn: 夏琳说：“这份工作提醒着我，要活在当下，在减少除草剂使用、维护校园安全与健康这件事上，扮演好自己的一份角色。”

en: Librarians know the value of their community services, and their patrons appreciate their importance as well. (16 words)
cn: 图书馆员深知自己所提供的社区服务的价值，而他们的读者也同样认可这份价值的重要性。

en: But in an increasingly digital world, we see the role of libraries as community and cultural centers at times undervalued. (20 words)
cn: 但在这个日益数字化的世界中，我们看到，图书馆作为社区与文化中心所扮演的角色，有时会被低估。

en: When shrinking municipal budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution, public library services that focus on building communities face-to-face, inspiring and educating patrons about art, literature, and music, and helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned. (38 words)
cn: 当日渐紧缩的市政预算，遇上永不停歇的科技革命，那些致力于面对面构建社区、向读者启发和普及艺术、文学与音乐、并帮助读者参与公共对话的公共图书馆服务，就可能显得有些过时。

en: But it is precisely those shrinking budgets and the assault of technologically mediated life that make public libraries' cultural and community offerings more important than ever. (26 words)
cn: 但恰恰正是这种日渐紧缩的预算、以及科技媒介化生活对我们的冲击，才使得公共图书馆所提供的文化与社区服务，比以往任何时候都更加重要。

en: Many people point out the value public libraries bring to their communities. (12 words)
cn: 许多人都指出了公共图书馆为其所在社区带来的价值。

en: More than just books and banks of computers, libraries are still places where individuals gather to explore, interact, and imagine. (20 words)
cn: 图书馆远不只是藏书与一排排电脑的集合，它们依然是人们聚集在一起探索、交流、想象的场所。

en: Some of the specific ways in which libraries add value to our communities and serve as cultural centers for our patrons are community builders, centers for the arts, and champions of youth. (32 words)
cn: 图书馆为社区增添价值、并作为读者文化中心而发挥作用的一些具体方式，包括充当社区建设者、艺术中心，以及青少年权益的倡导者。

en: Libraries serve in these capacities and are more than just about information. (12 words)
cn: 图书馆在这些方面都发挥着作用，其意义远不止于提供信息。

en: As community builders libraries are engaged in incredible work. (9 words)
cn: 作为社区建设者，图书馆正在从事着令人惊叹的工作。

en: From tiny public libraries to huge city institutions with multiple branches, libraries across the United States are building community and supporting local culture in exciting ways. (26 words)
cn: 从小型公共图书馆，到拥有众多分馆的大型城市机构，美国各地的图书馆都在以令人振奋的方式建设社区、扶持本地文化。

en: These are inspiring and hopefully will encourage librarians interested in community services and cultural outreach to make connections with each other, share ideas, and build partnerships. (26 words)
cn: 这些事例鼓舞人心，也有望激励那些对社区服务和文化推广感兴趣的图书馆员彼此建立联系、分享想法、构建合作伙伴关系。

en: Supporters of libraries as community builders claim that unless you are out there changing neighborhoods, you are not completing the work you are to do. (25 words)
cn: 支持“图书馆作为社区建设者”这一理念的人士主张，除非你真正走出去改变社区，否则就没有完成本该完成的工作。

en: Strengthening neighborhoods and championing the cultural lives of communities are big responsibilities. (12 words)
cn: 巩固社区、倡导社区的文化生活，是一项重大的责任。

en: Place-based economic development stresses the importance of offering attractive, functional, and community-based places, such as libraries, in town squares and depressed neighborhoods. (22 words)
cn: 以地方为基础的经济发展理念，强调在城镇广场和经济欠发达社区中，提供如图书馆这样具有吸引力、功能齐全、扎根社区的公共场所的重要性。

en: Like a major department store in a mall, libraries attract large numbers of people, creating economic opportunities for numerous businesses and organizations in the surrounding area. (26 words)
cn: 就像购物中心里的大型百货商店一样，图书馆能吸引大量人流，为周边众多商家和机构创造经济机遇。

en: Large cities, medium-sized ones, and even small towns have successfully transformed their libraries into the hubs (枢纽) of vibrant neighborhoods. (19 words)
cn: 大城市、中等城市，乃至小城镇，都已成功地将本地图书馆打造成了充满活力社区的枢纽。

en: As key municipal agencies, and focal points for community education, libraries are major players in creating livable, environmentally friendly cities and towns. (22 words)
cn: 作为重要的市政机构、也是社区教育的聚焦点，图书馆是打造宜居、环保城镇的重要参与者。

en: The Urban Libraries Council released a report detailing the unique ways in which libraries can further sustainability at the local level. (21 words)
cn: “城市图书馆理事会”发布了一份报告，详细阐述了图书馆在地方层面推动可持续发展的独特方式。

en: Beyond ensuring that library construction projects consider environmental impact, libraries can take a lead in supporting local foods and craftsmen, like the Peabody Institute Library's partnering with local businesses to pioneer a farmers' market in their courtyard, or the Richmond Public Library's seed lending library which "nurtures locally-adapted plant varieties, and fosters community resilience (韧性), self-reliance and a culture of sharing." (61 words)
cn: 除了确保图书馆建设项目会考量环境影响之外，图书馆还能在扶持本地食品和手工艺人方面发挥引领作用——比如皮博迪学院图书馆与本地商家合作，率先在其庭院内开办了一个农贸市场；又比如里士满公共图书馆的“种子借阅图书馆”，它“培育适应本地环境的植物品种，并培养社区的韧性、自力更生的精神与共享的文化”。

en: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups. (19 words)
cn: 档案馆保存着与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目，以及学术著作，其中也包括与少数族裔群体相关的内容。

en: Communities lucky enough to have archivists have a great advantage when it comes to organizing historical records and artifacts. (19 words)
cn: 有幸配备档案管理员的社区，在整理历史记录和文物方面，具有很大的优势。

en: An organized archive is a place where people can research their ancestry and immigration history, do environmental research, and more. (20 words)
cn: 一座管理有序的档案馆，是人们研究自己家族血统与移民历史、开展环境研究等诸多活动的场所。

en: An archivist is an advocate for preservation who, among other things, coordinates the restoration of maps and paintings, the digitization of vital records, and the creation of oral history projects. (30 words)
cn: 档案管理员是历史保护事业的倡导者，其职责之一便是统筹地图与绘画的修复、重要档案的数字化，以及口述历史项目的建立。

en: With projects like the Massachusetts Memories Road Show and the Veterans History Project, evidence of the importance of archives is everywhere. (21 words)
cn: 从“马萨诸塞记忆路演”到“退伍军人历史项目”，诸如此类的项目随处可见，无不彰显着档案馆的重要性。

en: In the words of Robert Putnam, "People may go to the library looking mainly for information, but they find each other there." (22 words)
cn: 正如罗伯特·帕特南所言：“人们去图书馆，或许主要是为了寻找信息，但他们却在那里找到了彼此。”

en: New moms connect at baby story-times; elderly people, often facing difficult life transitions, attend events and find that they make new friends; teenagers meet up in libraries' teen spaces after school; and readers discuss current events in the periodicals room. (40 words)
cn: 新手妈妈们在婴幼儿故事会上相识；常常面临艰难人生转折的老年人参加各类活动，从中结交新朋友；青少年在放学后聚集在图书馆的青少年活动空间；读者们则在期刊阅览室里畅谈时事。

en: In libraries, community-building connections are happening all the time. (9 words)
cn: 在图书馆里，构建社区联系的时刻，无时无刻不在发生。

en: As Keith Richards said, "The public library is the great equalizer." (11 words)
cn: 正如基思·理查兹所说：“公共图书馆是伟大的平等器。”

en: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend. (33 words)
cn: 尽管音乐会和戏剧演出的票价不断攀升，公共图书馆举办的各类活动（包括音乐会、作家见面会和画展）却常常是免费的，让任何收入水平的人都能前来参与。

en: In addition, library book groups allow people to explore and discuss the literary arts, and the Great Stories Club introduces at-risk youth to literature. (24 words)
cn: 此外，图书馆的读书小组让人们得以探索和讨论文学艺术，“伟大故事俱乐部”则让处境艰难的青少年得以接触文学。

en: The best part: it's all free and open to the public. (11 words)
cn: 最棒的是：这一切都是免费的，且向公众开放。

en: In a time when education is increasingly expensive, public libraries provide information and educational opportunities free for all people, regardless of their socio-economic status. (24 words)
cn: 在教育成本日益高昂的今天，公共图书馆为所有人——无论其社会经济地位如何——免费提供信息与教育机会。

en: Offered by libraries across the country, American Library Association's Let's Talk about It programs are wonderful examples of scholar-facilitated learning opportunities in libraries. (23 words)
cn: 由全国各地图书馆提供的美国图书馆协会“让我们聊聊”项目，就是图书馆中由学者带领学习机会的绝佳范例。

en: In addition, many libraries present classes and discussion programs, and some even provide online continuing education courses such as the Universal Class database. (23 words)
cn: 此外，许多图书馆还开设课程和讨论项目，一些图书馆甚至提供诸如“通用课堂”数据库这样的在线继续教育课程。

en: Librarians know that patrons aren't just information consumers, they're information producers. (11 words)
cn: 图书馆员深知，读者不仅仅是信息的消费者，也是信息的生产者。

en: Patrons use the library to gain knowledge in order to create their own new and independent works. (17 words)
cn: 读者利用图书馆汲取知识，从而创作出属于自己的全新的、独立的作品。

en: Increasing numbers of libraries provide spaces and services that meet the needs of people who want to learn how to edit Wikipedia, set up blogs or podcasts, create their own magazines, and so much more. (35 words)
cn: 越来越多的图书馆提供各类空间与服务，以满足那些想学习如何编辑维基百科、创建博客或播客、制作自己的杂志等诸多需求的人们。

en: Many libraries offer art or writing workshops and groups, and some provide music practice rooms for patrons. (17 words)
cn: 许多图书馆提供艺术或写作工作坊与小组，还有一些图书馆为读者提供音乐练习室。

en: Programs like ImaginOn in Charlotte, North Carolina, provide exciting models that take community partnership, creativity, and creation to a new level. (21 words)
cn: 像北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市的“ImaginOn”这样的项目，提供了令人振奋的范例，把社区合作、创造力与创作水平推向了一个新的高度。

en: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage—in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies. (40 words)
cn: 公共对话的式微，部分源于这样一个事实：无论是在虚拟世界还是现实世界中，人们都太容易只观看与自己背景和意识形态相似之人的新闻、只从他们那里购买产品、只与他们互动交往。

en: Public libraries, through such programs as The Human Library and Socrates Café, can help build small communities of difference that encourage people to interact with and learn from each other through dialogue. (32 words)
cn: 公共图书馆通过“真人图书馆”和“苏格拉底咖啡馆”等项目，能够帮助构建起一个个由不同背景的人组成的小型社群，鼓励人们通过对话彼此交流、相互学习。

en: By both actively promoting civil discourse through these programs, and modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all, libraries help individuals rediscover the importance of and increased need for civil discourse in American life. (38 words)
cn: 图书馆通过这些项目积极推动公共对话，同时以身作则、坚持面向所有人的自由探究和自由表达原则，帮助人们重新发现公共对话在美国生活中的重要性，以及对其日益增长的需求。

en: Free tutoring, homework help programs, and summer reading programs for kids and teens help bridge the economic divide that impacts students' academic performance. (23 words)
cn: 面向儿童和青少年的免费辅导、家庭作业帮助项目，以及暑期阅读项目，有助于弥合影响学生学业表现的经济鸿沟。

en: The cost of hiring a private tutor is well beyond what many library patrons can afford, so libraries offer homework help and tutoring online, by phone, in person, and even through social media and homework apps. (36 words)
cn: 聘请私人家教的费用，远远超出许多图书馆读者所能负担的范围，因此图书馆通过线上、电话、面对面，甚至社交媒体和作业类App等多种方式，提供作业帮助与辅导。

en: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events. (40 words)
cn: 每年一度的暑期阅读项目同样对学生成绩有积极影响；根据多米尼加大学图书馆与信息科学研究生院于2010年开展的一项研究，学生的阅读能力，会从这些风靡全国的活动中获得提升。

en: Through library collections, programs, and physical spaces, children learn to share, to be engaged in their communities, to participate in the arts, and to explore their immediate world and the world at large. (33 words)
cn: 通过图书馆的馆藏、项目和实体空间，孩子们学会了分享、参与所在社区、投身艺术，并探索身边的世界乃至更广阔的天地。

en: There are surely endless examples of innovative library services for children, including the Middle Country Public Library's Nature Explorium, which engages children in learning about the natural world. (28 words)
cn: 面向儿童的创新型图书馆服务，其实例可谓不胜枚举，其中就包括中乡镇公共图书馆的“自然探索馆”，它让孩子们得以在其中学习探索自然世界。

en: These examples are just a few of the many amazing things that public libraries around the United States (and the world) are doing to build and maintain strong community connections. (30 words)
cn: 以上这些例子，只是美国（乃至全世界）公共图书馆为建立和维系牢固的社区联系所做的诸多了不起的事情中的一小部分。

en: We encourage you to try some of these ideas in your own libraries, and we hope that these ideas will help you be better able to convince your community leaders of the important role that public libraries play in communities large and small. (43 words)
cn: 我们鼓励你也在自己所在的图书馆中尝试其中的一些做法，希望这些理念能帮助你更好地向社区领导者证明，公共图书馆无论是在大社区还是小社区中，都发挥着重要的作用。

en: Nationally, one in six children miss 15 or more days of school in a year. (15 words)
cn: 在全国范围内，每六名儿童中就有一人一年缺课15天或以上。

en: Education officials have deplored all this missed instruction. (8 words)
cn: 教育官员们对这种大量缺失的课堂教学深感忧虑。

en: These chronically absent students suffer academically because of all the classroom instruction they miss out on. (16 words)
cn: 这些长期缺勤的学生，因为错过了大量课堂教学，学业上受到了严重影响。

en: In 2015, the US secretary of education responded to this crisis, urging communities to support every student to attend every day and be successful in school. (26 words)
cn: 2015年，美国教育部长针对这一危机做出了回应，呼吁社区支持每一名学生每天到校、并在学业上取得成功。

en: His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement. (25 words)
cn: 他在一封公开信中指出，无论出于何种原因——有正当理由的请假还是无故缺勤——一年中缺课比例达到10%，都是导致学业成绩低下的主要原因之一。

en: Worrying about whether children attend school makes sense. (8 words)
cn: 担心孩子是否到校上课，是有道理的。

en: After all, if students don't show up, teachers can't teach them. (11 words)
cn: 毕竟，如果学生根本没有出现在课堂上，老师也就无从教导他们。

en: But what if America's attendance crisis is about much more than students missing class? (14 words)
cn: 但如果美国的出勤危机，其根源远不止于学生缺课本身呢？

en: What if, instead, it is a reflection of family and community crises these students face—such as being ejected from the family apartment, fearing for their safety in their neighborhood or suffering an illness? (33 words)
cn: 如果它实际上反映的，是这些学生所面临的家庭和社区层面的种种危机呢——比如被赶出家庭租住的公寓、担心自己在所住社区的人身安全，或是身患疾病？

en: As social scientists we investigated how excused and unexcused absences relate to children's academic achievement. (15 words)
cn: 作为社会科学研究者，我们调查了“有理由缺勤”与“无故缺勤”分别与儿童学业成绩之间的关系。

en: We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning. (14 words)
cn: 我们发现，经家长准假的缺勤，对孩子的学习几乎没有什么损害。

en: In fact, children with no unexcused absences—but 15 to 18 excused absences—have test scores equal to their peers who have no absences. (22 words)
cn: 事实上，那些没有任何无故缺勤记录——但有15至18天经准假缺勤——的孩子，其考试成绩与从未缺勤的同龄人不相上下。

en: Meanwhile, the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none. (18 words)
cn: 与此同时，哪怕只有一次无故缺勤记录，一般孩子的学业表现也会比从无缺勤记录的同龄人差得多。

en: We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face, including economic and medical hardships. (21 words)
cn: 我们认为，无故缺勤是一个强烈的信号，反映出儿童及其家庭正面临着诸多挑战，其中包括经济困境和医疗困难。

en: Unexcused absences can be a powerful signal of how those out-of-school challenges affect children's academic progress. (16 words)
cn: 无故缺勤能够有力地揭示出，这些发生在校外的种种挑战，是如何影响着孩子的学业进展的。

en: Our evidence suggests unexcused absences are problematic, but for a different reason than people often think. (16 words)
cn: 我们的研究证据表明，无故缺勤确实存在问题，但原因与人们通常所认为的并不相同。

en: Absence from school, and especially unexcused absence, matters mainly as a signal of many crises children and their families may be facing. (22 words)
cn: 缺课——尤其是无故缺勤——之所以重要，主要是因为它标志着孩子及其家庭可能正面临着诸多危机。

en: It matters less as a cause of lower student achievement due to missed instruction. (14 words)
cn: 而作为因错过课堂教学而导致学业成绩下滑的直接原因，其重要性则相对较小。

en: How we choose to think of school absences matters for educational policy. (12 words)
cn: 我们如何看待学生缺课这一问题，对教育政策的制定至关重要。

en: School attendance policies typically hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss, regardless of whether they were excused or unexcused absences. (23 words)
cn: 学校出勤政策通常会让学校和家庭对孩子所缺的课时负责，而不论这些缺勤究竟是经准假的，还是无故的。

en: These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically because they are missing classroom instruction. (18 words)
cn: 这些政策假定，无论出于何种原因缺课，都会因错过课堂教学而损害孩子的学业。

en: They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences. (15 words)
cn: 这些政策还假定，学校能够通过减少学生缺勤，来实施有效的干预。

en: We find neither to be the case. (7 words)
cn: 但我们的研究发现，这两种假设都不成立。

en: As a result, these attendance policies end up disproportionately punishing families dealing with out-of-school crises in their lives and pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often. (31 words)
cn: 结果，这些出勤政策最终对那些正在应对校外生活危机的家庭施加了不成比例的惩罚，同时也给服务这些家庭的学校施加压力，要求他们让学生更频繁地到校上课。

en: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most. (23 words)
cn: 相反，我们建议把无故缺勤当作一个信号，用它来把资源引导给那些最需要帮助的儿童和家庭。

en: After earning a bachelor's degree, I was determined to do what I love. (13 words)
cn: 获得学士学位后，我下定决心要去做自己热爱的事情。

en: I headed straight to graduate school to investigate the social problems that fascinated me. (14 words)
cn: 我直接读了研究生，去研究那些令我着迷的社会问题。

en: For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same. (15 words)
cn: 在将近十年的时间里，我逢人便说，他们也应该这样做。

en: "Follow your passion," I counseled. (5 words)
cn: “跟随你的热情去做选择，”我这样劝告别人。

en: "You can figure out the employment stuff later." (8 words)
cn: “至于就业的事，以后再想办法解决就好。”

en: It wasn't until I began to research this widely accepted career advice that I understood how problematic it really was. (20 words)
cn: 直到我开始对这条被广泛接受的职业建议展开研究，我才明白它究竟存在多大的问题。

en: As a sociologist, I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle. (30 words)
cn: 作为一名社会学家，我采访了大学生和职场人士，想了解“追寻梦想”这件事究竟意味着什么——在此，我将其称为“激情原则”。

en: I was stunned by what I found out about this principle in the research for my new book. (18 words)
cn: 在为我的新书进行研究的过程中，我对这一原则的相关发现感到震惊不已。

en: Surveys show the American public has long held the passion principle in high regard as a career decision-making priority. (19 words)
cn: 调查显示，长久以来，美国公众一直把“激情原则”视为职业决策中备受推崇的优先考量因素。

en: And its popularity is even stronger among those facing job instability. (11 words)
cn: 而在那些面临就业不稳定的人群中，这一原则更是格外受到追捧。

en: Advocates of the passion principle found it compelling because they believed that following one's passion can provide workers with both the motivation necessary to work hard and a place to find fulfillment. (32 words)
cn: “激情原则”的拥护者认为这一理念极具说服力，因为他们相信，追随自己的热情，既能给劳动者提供努力工作所需的动力，也能为他们提供一个获得成就感的场所。

en: Yet, what I found is that following one's passion does not necessarily lead to fulfillment, but is one of the most powerful cultural forces perpetuating overwork. (26 words)
cn: 然而，我的发现却是：追随自己的热情，并不一定会带来成就感，反而是助长过度劳动这一文化现象最为强大的力量之一。

en: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease. (35 words)
cn: 我还发现，鼓励人们追寻热情，实际上助长了社会不平等的延续，因为并非所有人都拥有同等的经济资源，能够轻松地去追随自己的热情。

en: While the passion principle is broadly popular, not everyone has the necessary resources to turn their passion into a stable, good-paying job. (22 words)
cn: 尽管“激情原则”广受欢迎，但并非人人都拥有必要的资源，能把自己的热情转化为一份稳定、薪酬优渥的工作。

en: Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans in the meantime. (26 words)
cn: 出身富裕家庭的“追梦者”，更有能力耐心等待自己心仪的工作出现，而不必在此期间为学生贷款而发愁。

en: They are also better situated to take unpaid internships to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent. (22 words)
cn: 他们也更有条件去接受无薪实习，以此打开职业道路的大门，同时由父母替他们支付房租。

en: And they often have access to parents' social networks to help them find jobs. (14 words)
cn: 而且，他们往往还能借助父母的人脉网络，来帮助自己找到工作。

en: Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion. (32 words)
cn: 调查显示，无论从事哪个职业领域，工人阶级家庭出身以及家中第一代大学毕业生，在追随自己的热情时，比家境更富裕的同龄人更有可能最终从事低薪的非技术性工作。

en: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants. (26 words)
cn: 那些向所有人推广“追随热情”这条道路、却未能拉平竞争起点的高校、职场和职业顾问，实际上助长了求职者之间社会经济不平等的持续存在。

en: It's not just well-off passion-seekers who benefit from the passion principle. (11 words)
cn: 从“激情原则”中获益的，并不仅仅是家境优越的“追梦者”。

en: Employers of passionate workers do, too. (6 words)
cn: 雇佣这些满怀热情员工的雇主，同样也从中受益。

en: Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay. (27 words)
cn: 潜在雇主对满怀热情的求职者表现出更大的兴趣，部分原因在于，他们认为这些求职者会在工作中努力付出，却不会期待加薪。

en: They even sacrifice a good salary, job stability and leisure time to work in a job they love. (18 words)
cn: 为了从事自己热爱的工作，这些求职者甚至甘愿牺牲优渥的薪水、稳定的职位，以及闲暇时光。

en: The slow progress of women in elective office is frustrating for some political observers and experts—including myself. (17 words)
cn: 女性在民选公职中晋升缓慢的现状，令一些政治观察人士和专家——包括我本人在内——都感到沮丧。

en: Achieving gender equality in Congress is an important goal. (9 words)
cn: 在国会中实现性别平等，是一个重要的目标。

en: This is because the number of women involved in legislative decisions has significant consequences for all the policies that governments enact. (21 words)
cn: 这是因为，参与立法决策的女性人数，会对政府所颁布的各项政策产生重大影响。

en: Female legislators are more likely than men to introduce, speak about and work to pass policies that disproportionately affect women and girls, such as paid family leave, pay equity and gender-based violence. (32 words)
cn: 相比男性立法者，女性立法者更倾向于提出、发声支持并推动通过那些对女性和女孩影响尤为深远的政策，比如带薪家事假、同工同酬以及针对性别的暴力问题。

en: Having more women in Congress also fosters a greater sense of connection between female voters and government. (17 words)
cn: 国会中女性人数的增加，也有助于增进女性选民与政府之间的联系感。

en: In addition, it bolsters women's sense that government cares about their concerns and inspires young women to become more politically engaged. (21 words)
cn: 此外，这还能增强女性“政府在意她们所关切之事”的这种感受，并激励年轻女性更加积极地参与政治。

en: While women are underrepresented in governments around the globe, it is a particularly formidable problem in the United States. (19 words)
cn: 尽管女性在全球各国政府中的代表性都普遍不足，但在美国，这一问题尤为严峻。

en: Currently, the US ranks 73rd in the world when it comes to female representation in government. (16 words)
cn: 目前，就政府中女性代表比例而言，美国在全球排名第73位。

en: But the reason women are so dramatically underrepresented in US government is not because they face resistance from voters or struggle to raise money. (24 words)
cn: 但女性在美国政府中代表性如此严重不足的原因，并不在于她们受到选民的抵制，或是难以筹集竞选资金。

en: On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar credentials. (24 words)
cn: 恰恰相反，数十年的研究表明，与拥有相似履历的男性政治人物相比，女性候选人筹集到的资金同样多，胜选的概率也同样高。

en: Rather, the slow progress of women in politics is a tale of two political parties. (15 words)
cn: 毋宁说，女性在政坛上进展缓慢的故事，其实是一则关于两大政党的故事。

en: In the next Congress, there will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers in the Senate and House combined. (22 words)
cn: 在下一届国会中，参众两院合计将有107名民主党女性议员，以及42名共和党女性议员。

en: In order for women to gain half of the seats in Congress, more women need to run, especially on Republican tickets. (21 words)
cn: 要让女性获得国会中一半的席位，就需要有更多女性参选，尤其是代表共和党参选。

en: This will require the Republican Party as a whole to prioritize recruiting women—and not just for one election cycle, but in a sustained way. (24 words)
cn: 这将要求共和党整体上把招募女性候选人作为优先事项——而且不仅仅是在某一次选举周期中如此，而是要持续不断地坚持下去。

en: I can be a reluctant socialiser. (6 words)
cn: 我有时是个不太情愿参与社交的人。

en: I'm sometimes secretly pleased when social plans are called off. (10 words)
cn: 当社交计划被取消时，我有时会暗自感到高兴。

en: I get restless a few hours into a hangout. (9 words)
cn: 参加聚会才过去几个小时，我就会开始坐立不安。

en: I even once went on a free 10-day silent meditation (冥想) retreat—not for the meditation, but for the silence. (18 words)
cn: 我甚至还曾参加过一次为期十天、免费的静默冥想静修——去参加的目的并非冥想本身，而是为了那份寂静。

en: So I can relate to author Anneli Rufus, who wrote in Party of One: The Loners' Manifesto: (17 words)
cn: 因此，我很能理解作家安内莉·鲁夫斯，她在《独自一人：独行者宣言》一书中写道：

en: "When parents on TV shows punished their kids by ordering them to go to their rooms, I was confused." (19 words)
cn: “当电视节目里的父母通过命令孩子回房间来惩罚他们时，我感到很困惑。”

en: "I loved my room." (4 words)
cn: “我喜欢待在自己的房间里。”

en: "Being there behind a locked door was a treat." (9 words)
cn: “待在紧锁的房门后面，对我来说是一种享受。”

en: "To me a punishment was being ordered to play games with my cousin Louis." (14 words)
cn: “对我来说，真正的惩罚是被要求去和表哥路易斯一起玩游戏。”

en: Unsocial tendencies like these are often far from ideal. (9 words)
cn: 像这样不善社交的倾向，往往并不算是理想的状态。

en: Abundant research shows the harms of social isolation, considered a serious public health problem in countries that have rapidly ageing populations (though talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated). (30 words)
cn: 大量研究表明了社会孤立所带来的危害，在人口迅速老龄化的国家，这被视为一个严重的公共卫生问题（尽管所谓“孤独症流行病”的说法可能有些夸大其词）。

en: In the UK, the Royal College of General Practitioners says that loneliness has the same risk level for premature death as diabetes. (22 words)
cn: 在英国，皇家全科医生学会指出，孤独感所带来的早逝风险，与糖尿病处于同一水平。

en: Strong social connections are important for cognitive functioning, motor function and a smoothly running immune system. (16 words)
cn: 牢固的社会联系对认知功能、运动机能以及免疫系统的正常运转，都十分重要。

en: This is especially clear from cases of extreme social isolation. (10 words)
cn: 这一点，从极端社会孤立的案例中体现得尤为明显。

en: Examples of people kept in captivity, children kept isolated in abusive orphanages, and prisoners kept in solitary confinement all show how prolonged solitude can lead to hallucinations (幻觉) and other forms of mental instability. (33 words)
cn: 被囚禁的人、在虐待性孤儿院中被隔离的儿童，以及被单独监禁的囚犯，这些例子无不表明，长期的独处会引发幻觉以及其他形式的精神不稳定。

en: But these are severe and involuntary cases of aloneness. (9 words)
cn: 但这些都是极端且非自愿的独处案例。

en: For those of us who just prefer plenty of alone time, emerging research suggests some good news: there are upsides to being alone—for both our work lives and our emotional well-being. (31 words)
cn: 对于我们这些只是单纯偏好拥有大量独处时间的人来说，新近的研究传递出一些好消息：独处也有其益处——无论是对我们的工作生活，还是情感健康而言，都是如此。

en: Solitude is a time for reflection, for thinking about things more deeply. (12 words)
cn: 独处是一段用来反思、深入思考问题的时光。

en: In a world increasingly focused on speed and competitiveness, solitude is precious and something to be treasured. (17 words)
cn: 在一个日益推崇速度和竞争力的世界里，独处显得弥足珍贵，值得我们去珍视。

en: And there are benefits in learning to love your solitude. (10 words)
cn: 而学会热爱自己的独处时光，也能带来诸多益处。

en: One key benefit of solitude is improved creativity. (8 words)
cn: 独处的一大关键益处，是能够提升创造力。

en: Gregory Feist, who focuses on the psychology of creativity at California's San Jose State University, has defined creativity as thinking or activity with two key elements: originality and usefulness. (29 words)
cn: 格雷戈里·菲斯特是加州圣何塞州立大学专注于创造力心理学研究的学者，他将创造力定义为兼具两大关键要素——原创性与实用性——的思维或活动。

en: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy—which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone". (36 words)
cn: 他发现，通常与创造力相关联的人格特质包括开放性（对新思想和新体验的接纳程度）、自信，以及自主性——而这种自主性可能包含“对社会规范的不太在意”以及“偏好独处”这两种表现。

en: In fact, Feist's research on both artists and scientists shows that one of the most prominent features of creative folks is their lesser interest in socialising. (26 words)
cn: 事实上，菲斯特针对艺术家和科学家所做的研究表明，富有创造力之人最为突出的特征之一，便是他们对社交的兴趣相对较低。

en: One reason for this is that such people are likely to spend sustained time alone working on their craft. (19 words)
cn: 造成这一现象的原因之一，是这类人往往会长时间独自投入到自己的技艺创作之中。

en: Plus, Feist says, many artists "are trying to make sense of their internal world and a lot of internal personal experiences that they're trying to give expression and meaning to through their art." (33 words)
cn: 此外，菲斯特表示，许多艺术家“都在试图理解自己的内心世界，以及大量内在的个人体验，并试图通过自己的艺术，赋予这些体验以表达和意义”。

en: Solitude allows for the reflection and observation necessary for that creative process. (12 words)
cn: 独处为这一创造过程所必需的反思与观察，提供了必要的空间。

en: A recent justification of these ideas came from University at Buffalo psychologist Julie Bowker, who researches social withdrawal. (18 words)
cn: 布法罗大学研究社会退缩现象的心理学家朱莉·鲍克，最近为这些观点提供了新的佐证。

en: Social withdrawal is usually categorised into three types: shyness caused by fear or anxiety; avoidance, from a dislike of socialising; and unsociability, from a preference for solitude. (27 words)
cn: 社会退缩通常被划分为三种类型：由恐惧或焦虑引起的害羞；源于不喜欢社交的回避；以及源于偏好独处的不合群。

en: A paper by Bowker and her colleagues was the first to show that a type of social withdrawal could have a positive effect—they found that creativity was linked specifically to unsociability. (31 words)
cn: 鲍克与同事发表的一篇论文，首次证明了某一类型的社会退缩可能带来积极效果——他们发现，创造力恰恰与“不合群”这一类型密切相关。

en: They also found that unsociability had no correlation with aggression (shyness and avoidance did). (14 words)
cn: 他们还发现，“不合群”与攻击性之间并无关联（而害羞与回避则与攻击性相关）。

en: This was significant because while previous research had suggested that unsociability might be harmless, Bowker and colleagues' paper showed that it could actually be beneficial. (25 words)
cn: 这一发现意义重大，因为此前的研究只是表明“不合群”或许无害，而鲍克及其同事的这篇论文，却证明它实际上可能是有益的。

en: Unsociable people are likely to be "having just enough interaction," Bowker says. (12 words)
cn: 鲍克说，不合群的人往往“恰好保持着足够的社交互动”。

en: "They have a preference for being alone, but they also don't mind being with others." (15 words)
cn: “他们偏好独处，但同时也并不介意和别人待在一起。”

en: Still, it turns out that solitude is important for more than creativity. (12 words)
cn: 不过，事实证明，独处的重要性还不止于创造力这一方面。

en: It's commonly believed that leaders need to be sociable. (9 words)
cn: 人们普遍认为，领导者需要善于社交。

en: But this depends, among other things, on the personalities of their employees. (12 words)
cn: 但这在很大程度上，也取决于其员工的性格特点等诸多因素。

en: One 2011 study showed that in branches of a pizza chain where employees were more passive, outgoing bosses were associated with higher profits. (23 words)
cn: 2011年的一项研究显示，在一家比萨连锁店那些员工较为被动的分店，性格外向的老板往往与更高的利润相关联。

en: But in branches where employees were more active, introverted (内向的) leaders were more effective. (13 words)
cn: 但在员工较为主动的分店里，性格内向的领导者则更为有效。

en: One reason for this is that introverted people are less likely to feel threatened by strong personalities and suggestions. (19 words)
cn: 造成这一现象的原因之一是，性格内向的人不太容易因强势的个性和建议而感到自己受到威胁。

en: They're also more likely to listen. (6 words)
cn: 他们也更倾向于倾听他人的意见。

en: Since ancient times, meanwhile, people have been aware of a link between isolation and mental focus. (16 words)
cn: 与此同时，自古以来，人们就已意识到孤独与精神专注之间存在着某种联系。

en: After all, cultures with traditions of religious hermits (隐士) believe that solitude is important for enlightenment. (15 words)
cn: 毕竟，那些拥有宗教隐士传统的文化，普遍相信独处对于开悟至关重要。

en: Recent research has given us a better understanding of why. (10 words)
cn: 近期的研究，让我们对其中的原因有了更深入的理解。

en: One benefit of unsociability is the brain's state of active mental rest, which goes hand-in-hand with the stillness of being alone. (21 words)
cn: 不合群带来的一项益处，是大脑得以进入一种“主动式精神休息”的状态，而这种状态与独处时的静谧密切相伴。

en: When another person is present, your brain can't help but pay some attention. (13 words)
cn: 当身边有另一个人在场时，你的大脑总会不由自主地分出一部分注意力去关注对方。

en: This can be a positive distraction. (6 words)
cn: 这可以是一种积极的分心。

en: But it's still a distraction. (5 words)
cn: 但它终究还是一种分心。

en: Daydreaming in the absence of such distractions activates the brain's default-mode network. (12 words)
cn: 在没有这类干扰的情况下进行白日梦，会激活大脑的“默认模式网络”。

en: Among other functions, this network helps to consolidate memory and understand others' emotions. (13 words)
cn: 这一神经网络具有多种功能，其中包括帮助巩固记忆、以及理解他人的情绪。

en: Giving free rein to a wandering mind not only helps with focus in the long term but strengthens your sense of both yourself and others. (25 words)
cn: 任由思绪自由游荡，不仅有助于从长远来看提升专注力，还能增强你对自身以及他人的感知力。

en: Paradoxically, therefore, periods of solitude actually help when it comes time to socialise once more. (15 words)
cn: 因此，颇为矛盾的是，独处的时光实际上有助于我们在重新回归社交时表现得更好。

en: And the occasional absence of focus ultimately helps concentration in the long run. (13 words)
cn: 而偶尔的注意力游离，从长远来看，最终反而有助于集中注意力。

en: A more recent advocate of thoughtful and productive solitude is Susan Cain, author of Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking and founder of Quiet Revolution, a company that promotes quiet and introvert-friendly workplaces. (39 words)
cn: 近年来，另一位倡导“深思熟虑、富有成效的独处”理念的人物是苏珊·凯恩，她是《安静：内向性格的竞争力》一书的作者，也是“安静革命”公司的创始人，该公司致力于推广安静、对内向者友好的职场环境。

en: "These days, we tend to believe that creativity emerges from a decidedly unreserved socialising process, but in fact it requires sustained attention and deep focus," she says. (27 words)
cn: 她说：“如今，我们往往认为创造力源自一种毫无保留的社交过程，但事实上，它需要的是持续的专注和深度的投入。”

en: "Also, humans are such absorbent social beings that when we surround ourselves with others, we automatically take in their opinions and aesthetics." (22 words)
cn: “此外，人类是极易受影响的社会性生物，当我们身处他人环绕之中时，会不自觉地吸收他们的观点和审美。”

en: "To truly chart our own path or vision, we have to be willing to isolate ourselves, at least for some period of time." (23 words)
cn: “要想真正规划出属于自己的道路或愿景，我们就必须愿意让自己独处，至少要在某段时间内如此。”

en: Still, the line between useful solitude and dangerous isolation can be blurry. (12 words)
cn: 然而，“有益的独处”与“危险的孤立”之间的界限，有时可能十分模糊。

en: "Almost anything can be adaptive and maladaptive, depending on how extreme they get," Feist says. (15 words)
cn: 菲斯特说：“几乎任何事情，一旦走向极端，都既可能是适应性的，也可能是适应不良的。”

en: A disorder has to do with dysfunction. (7 words)
cn: 一种障碍与功能失调息息相关。

en: If someone stops caring about people and cuts off all contact, this could point to an irrational neglect of social relations. (21 words)
cn: 如果一个人不再关心他人、断绝一切社交往来，这可能表明他对人际关系存在一种非理性的忽视。

en: But creative unsociability is a far cry from this. (9 words)
cn: 但富有创造力的“不合群”，与这种情况相去甚远。

en: In fact, Feist says, "there's a real danger with people who are never alone." (14 words)
cn: 事实上，菲斯特说：“那些从不独处的人，反而存在着真实的风险。”

en: It's hard to examine one's own thoughts, feelings and motives, to be self-aware, and fully relaxed unless you have occasional solitude. (21 words)
cn: 除非你能偶尔拥有独处的时光，否则很难去审视自己的想法、感受与动机，也很难做到真正的自我觉察和彻底放松。

en: In addition, introverts tend to have fewer but stronger friendships—which has been linked to greater happiness. (16 words)
cn: 此外，内向的人往往拥有数量较少、但关系更为牢固的友谊——而这已被证实与更高的幸福感相关联。

en: As with many things, quality reigns over quantity. (8 words)
cn: 正如许多事情一样，质量胜过数量。

en: Nurturing a few solid relationships without feeling the need to constantly populate your life with endless chatting ultimately may be better for you. (23 words)
cn: 培养少数几段牢固的关系，而不必觉得有必要用没完没了的闲聊来填满自己的生活，或许最终对你更有益处。

en: Thus, if your personality tends toward unsociability, you shouldn't feel the need to change. (14 words)
cn: 因此，如果你的性格本就倾向于不合群，你不必觉得有必要去改变自己。

en: Of course, that comes with qualifications. (6 words)
cn: 当然，这也是有前提条件的。

en: But as long as you have regular social contact, you are choosing solitude rather than being forced into it, you have at least a few good friends and your solitude is good for your well-being or productivity, there's no point agonising over how to fit a square personality into a round hole. (52 words)
cn: 但只要你保持着规律的社交往来，你选择独处是出于主动而非被迫，你至少拥有几个知心好友，而且独处确实有益于你的身心健康或工作效率，那么就没必要为如何把方形的性格硬塞进圆形的洞里而苦恼纠结。

en: Simulators are most often utilized within industries such as nuclear power, aviation and surgery where failure results in disastrous consequences. (20 words)
cn: 模拟器最常应用于核能、航空和外科手术等一旦失误便会带来灾难性后果的行业。

en: To maximize the value from a simulation learning experience, participants should immediately and directly apply their learning to a specific intervention within their organization. (24 words)
cn: 为了最大限度地发挥模拟学习经验的价值，参与者应当立即、直接地将所学应用到本组织内一项具体的干预行动之中。

en: Most organizations aspire to deploy significant change programs, only to find them nearly impossible to implement. (16 words)
cn: 大多数组织都渴望推行重大的变革项目，却往往发现这些项目几乎难以真正落地实施。

en: That is largely because successful change requires more than a vision; it requires a workforce that not only doesn't resist change, but embraces it. (24 words)
cn: 这在很大程度上是因为，成功的变革所需要的，不仅仅是一个愿景；它还需要一支不仅不抵触变革、反而主动拥抱变革的员工队伍。

en: To achieve success, an organization must build a transformation program that will allow change to be rapidly pulled across its departments and throughout its layers. (25 words)
cn: 要取得成功，一个组织必须构建这样一套变革方案：能够让变革迅速贯穿其各个部门与各个层级。

en: Regardless of the level of senior management commitment, unless key thought leaders at all levels embrace the change, the initiative will wither and die. (24 words)
cn: 无论高层管理者的投入程度有多高，除非各个层级的关键意见领袖都真正拥抱这场变革，否则这项变革举措终将逐渐凋零、归于消亡。

en: To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be, which will enable them to rethink their mental models, enable them to break free from their deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn. (41 words)
cn: 要激发出这种广泛的热情，学习引导者必须让员工接触到“可能实现的未来图景”，从而使他们能够重新审视自己固有的思维模式，摆脱根深蒂固的思维范式，并把握住学习的机会。

en: Allowing participants to enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs. (25 words)
cn: 让参与者进入一个模拟环境，能为他们提供一个体验“另一种现实”的机会，从而促使他们重新审视自己当下所持有的种种信念。

en: Behavioral change is not easy for most adults. (8 words)
cn: 对于大多数成年人来说，行为上的改变并非易事。

en: Lectures, training programs and workshops can explain the intellectual elements of transformation, but they are seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects that lie at the heart of a significant change initiative. (33 words)
cn: 讲座、培训项目和工作坊固然能够阐释变革中理性认知层面的内容，但它们却很少能有效触及一项重大变革举措核心所在的行为层面。

en: Further, under normal working conditions, managers rarely see the full effect of their employee development efforts. (16 words)
cn: 此外，在正常的工作条件下，管理者也很少能看到自己在员工培养方面所付出努力的全部成效。

en: As such, an intervention like a simulation can provide the stimulus for change. (13 words)
cn: 有鉴于此，像模拟训练这样的干预手段，便能够为变革提供有力的推动力。

en: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning. (28 words)
cn: 一场行之有效的模拟训练，作为学习工具，可能比实际经验更为出色，因为它能够加速时间进程、压缩空间跨度，而且与现实不同，它是专门为最大限度地提升参与者学习效果而设计的。

en: Simulations provide an immersive learning experience where skills, processes and knowledge all can be highlighted in a way reality cannot. (20 words)
cn: 模拟训练提供了一种沉浸式的学习体验，能够以现实无法企及的方式，将技能、流程与知识凸显出来。

en: The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning. (26 words)
cn: 在不受限制、且没有风险的模型中反复探索、试验并运用新知识的这种能力，正是模拟训练成为最富成效的学习形式之一的原因所在。

en: Well-designed simulations can enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding about how their decisions and intuitive responses to business stimuli affect their fellow participants and the organization as a whole. (34 words)
cn: 设计精良的模拟训练，能够让个人和团队深入理解自己的决策以及对商业刺激的直觉反应，会如何影响其他参与者以及整个组织。

en: To reap the benefits, however, simulations must feel like reality. (10 words)
cn: 然而，要真正获得这些益处，模拟训练必须让人感觉如同真实情境一般。

en: At the end of the successful simulation, participants must declare "this is us." (13 words)
cn: 在一场成功的模拟训练结束时，参与者必须能够由衷地说出“这就是我们自己”。

en: If they don't, they will view the experience as a game, which can be difficult to apply on the job, or worse, irrelevant to everyday work tasks. (27 words)
cn: 如果做不到这一点，他们就会把这次体验当作一场游戏，这样一来，其经验便难以运用到实际工作中，更糟的是，还可能被视为与日常工作任务毫不相关。

en: To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing. (23 words)
cn: 为了最大限度地从模拟训练中获益，参与者应当立即运用从中所学，从而在“学”与“做”之间锻造出一条顺畅的连接纽带。

en: GDP growth is not a good indicator of how well a country is performing, and should not be the primary goal of governments. (23 words)
cn: GDP增长并不是衡量一个国家表现好坏的良好指标，也不应成为政府的首要目标。

en: Unlimited growth is not sustainable, and economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability in our economic models. (23 words)
cn: 无限度的增长是不可持续的，而经济学思维正逐渐转向这样一种理念：我们应当在经济模式中追求可持续性。

en: But while a sustainable economy is vital to our future, it is a means to an end, not an end in itself. (22 words)
cn: 但尽管可持续的经济对我们的未来至关重要，它终究只是达成目的的手段，而非目的本身。

en: The idea that governments should focus on happiness has its critics. (11 words)
cn: “政府应当把幸福作为施政重点”这一理念，也遭到了一些批评者的质疑。

en: There are concerns about how happiness can be measured. (9 words)
cn: 人们担心的问题之一在于：幸福究竟该如何加以衡量。

en: Is happiness not a fleeting and subjective psychological state? (9 words)
cn: 难道幸福不是一种转瞬即逝、且带有主观性的心理状态吗？

en: Don't different people experience different levels of happiness? (8 words)
cn: 不同的人所体验到的幸福程度，难道不是各不相同的吗？

en: Even on the broadest interpretation of 'happiness' as prosperity or 'life satisfaction', people want different things. (16 words)
cn: 即便将“幸福”最宽泛地解读为“繁荣”或“生活满意度”，不同的人所追求的东西，依然各不相同。

en: Of course, governments cannot impose life satisfaction on citizens. (9 words)
cn: 当然，政府无法把生活满意度强加于公民身上。

en: But our happiness relies on collaborative efforts as a society. (10 words)
cn: 但我们的幸福，依赖于整个社会的协作努力。

en: A government's obligation lies in creating conditions that promote prosperity. (10 words)
cn: 政府的职责在于，创造出能够促进繁荣的种种条件。

en: And there is good reason to suppose that such conditions exist, are globally applicable, and are discoverable through research. (19 words)
cn: 而且我们有充分的理由相信，这样的条件确实存在，并具有全球普适性，也能够通过研究被发掘出来。

en: In a recently published article, philosopher Julian Baggini suggests we should focus on "real wealth" for citizens, which does not depend on GDP growth. (24 words)
cn: 哲学家朱利安·巴吉尼在一篇近期发表的文章中提出，我们应当聚焦于公民的“真实财富”，而这种财富并不依赖于GDP的增长。

en: Access is key: people do not need to own, but rather access things that enable them to live well. (19 words)
cn: 关键在于“可获取性”：人们并不需要真正拥有某物，而只需能够获取那些能让自己过上美好生活的事物即可。

en: Technological advances and changes in social behavior enable us to make more efficient use of the assets that we already have. (21 words)
cn: 技术的进步与社会行为的变化，使我们能够更高效地利用自己已经拥有的资产。

en: And focusing on access to the resources people need to live better lives could help reduce inequality. (17 words)
cn: 而聚焦于人们获取过上更好生活所需资源的机会，有助于减少不平等。

en: As far as it goes, this has much in common with proposals tabled by 'happiness' advocates. (16 words)
cn: 就其本身而言，这一观点与“幸福”倡导者所提出的主张有着诸多相似之处。

en: But it sets the bar far too low for what governments can and should be doing for their citizens. (19 words)
cn: 但对于政府能够、也应当为公民所做的事情而言，这一标准设定得未免过低了。

en: For example, it's not clear how a 'real wealth' economy would remedy the epidemic of mental ill-health that plagues our society. (21 words)
cn: 举例来说，“真实财富”经济究竟该如何应对困扰我们社会的心理健康问题这一流行病，目前尚不明朗。

en: In Western countries, at least—poor mental health is more detrimental to wellbeing than poverty. (14 words)
cn: 至少在西方国家，心理健康状况不佳，对幸福感的损害要甚于贫困本身。

en: Over and above a vastly improved provision of therapeutic mental healthcare, there are preventative measures for improving mental health that governments could and should adopt. (25 words)
cn: 除了大幅改善治疗性心理健康服务的供给之外，还存在一些政府本可以、也应当采取的预防性措施，来改善心理健康状况。

en: The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation—educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental wellbeing. (19 words)
cn: 世界卫生组织建议建立能够促进社区参与的机构——包括提供各类促进心理健康技能的教育项目与干预措施。

en: It says a lot, however, that the WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to persuade governments that the cost of taking proposed measures is justified. (33 words)
cn: 然而，颇能说明问题的是，世界卫生组织竟然觉得有必要诉诸“改善心理健康所带来的经济效益”，来说服各国政府相信，采取这些举措所需的成本是合理的。

en: As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity. (18 words)
cn: 只要经济增长仍是政府的首要考量，那么它们所做的，也就不过是确保公民持续维持生产力而已，无需再多做什么。

en: To demand that governments set the "happiness" of citizens as their highest priority is to demand that they view citizens as ends in themselves. (24 words)
cn: 要求政府把公民的“幸福”置于最优先的位置，实际上就是要求政府把公民本身视为目的，而非达成其他目的的手段。

en: No beast on Earth is tougher than the tiny tardigrade (缓步类动物). (11 words)
cn: 地球上没有哪种生物比微小的缓步动物更强悍。

en: It can survive being frozen at -272℃, being exposed to the vacuum of outer space and even being blasted with 500 times the dose of X-rays that would kill a human. (31 words)
cn: 它能在零下272摄氏度的低温下被冻结而存活下来，能暴露于外太空的真空环境中，甚至能承受足以致人于死地的500倍剂量的X射线轰击。

en: In other words, the creature can endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth. (14 words)
cn: 换句话说，这种生物所能承受的环境条件，在地球上甚至根本不存在。

en: And researchers are looking to the microscopic animals to learn how to prepare humans and crops to handle the rigors of space travel. (23 words)
cn: 研究人员正试图从这种微小的生物身上，学习如何帮助人类和农作物应对太空旅行的严酷考验。

en: The tardigrade's indestructibility stems from its adaptations to its environment—which may seem surprising, since it lives in seemingly comfortable places, like the cool, wet patches of moss (青苔) that dot a garden wall. (32 words)
cn: 缓步动物之所以坚不可摧，源于它对所处环境的种种适应——这或许令人感到意外，因为它其实生活在看似颇为舒适的地方，比如点缀在花园围墙上、阴凉潮湿的苔藓斑块。

en: But it turns out that a tardigrade's damp, mossy home can dry out many times each year. (17 words)
cn: 但事实证明，缓步动物这个潮湿、长满苔藓的家园，每年都会经历多次干涸。

en: Drying is pretty catastrophic for most living things. (8 words)
cn: 对大多数生物来说，干燥都堪称是一场灾难。

en: It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do. (17 words)
cn: 它对细胞造成的损害，在某些方面与冷冻、真空和辐射所造成的损害颇为相似。

en: Tardigrades, however, have evolved special strategies for dealing with these kinds of damage. (13 words)
cn: 然而，缓步动物已经进化出了应对这类损害的特殊策略。

en: As a tardigrade dries out, its cells produce several strange proteins that are unlike anything found in other animals. (19 words)
cn: 当缓步动物体内水分流失时，其细胞会产生几种奇特的蛋白质，这些蛋白质与其他动物体内所发现的任何蛋白质都截然不同。

en: In water, the proteins are shapeless. (6 words)
cn: 在有水的环境中，这些蛋白质是没有固定形态的。

en: But as water disappears, the proteins self-assemble into long fibers that fill the cell's interior. (15 words)
cn: 但随着水分的消失，这些蛋白质会自行组装成长长的纤维，填满整个细胞内部。

en: The fibers support the cell's membranes (细胞膜) and proteins, preventing them from breaking or unfolding. (14 words)
cn: 这些纤维支撑着细胞膜和其他蛋白质，防止它们破裂或展开变性。

en: Emulating tardigrades could one day help humans colonize outer space. (10 words)
cn: 效仿缓步动物的这套机制，或许有朝一日能帮助人类实现太空殖民。

en: Food crops could be engineered to produce tardigrade proteins, allowing these organisms to grow more efficiently on spacecraft where levels of radiation are elevated compared with on Earth. (28 words)
cn: 农作物可以经过基因改造，使其产生缓步动物蛋白质，从而让这些生物能在辐射水平高于地球的航天器上更高效地生长。

en: So if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars, they may accomplish this feat, in part, by standing on the shoulders of the tiny eight-legged endurance specialists in your backyard. (30 words)
cn: 因此，如果人类最终成功飞向群星，那么在一定程度上，他们或许正是站在你家后院那些微小的“八足耐力专家”的肩膀上，才实现了这一壮举。

en: As the scale and impacts of climate change become increasingly alarming, meat is a popular target for action. (18 words)
cn: 随着气候变化的规模与影响日益令人担忧，肉类成为了行动矛头指向的一个热门目标。

en: Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat. (19 words)
cn: 致力于保护自然环境免遭破坏或污染的倡导者们，呼吁公众减少肉类摄入。

en: Some activists have even called for taxing meat to reduce consumption of it. (13 words)
cn: 一些活动人士甚至呼吁对肉类征税，以减少其消费量。

en: A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector. (20 words)
cn: 支撑这些论点的一个关键说法是：在全球范围内，肉类生产所产生的温室气体，比整个交通运输行业还要多。

en: However, this claim is demonstrably wrong, as I will show. (10 words)
cn: 然而，正如我接下来将要证明的那样，这一说法显然是错误的。

en: And its persistence has led to false assumptions about the linkage between meat and climate change. (16 words)
cn: 而这一说法的持续流传，也导致了人们对肉类与气候变化之间关联的错误假设。

en: My recent research focuses on ways in which animal agriculture affects air quality and climate change. (16 words)
cn: 我近期的研究，聚焦于畜牧业影响空气质量与气候变化的各种方式。

en: In my view, there are many reasons for either choosing animal protein or opting for a vegetarian selection. (18 words)
